stories.hook: ¿Puede una sola sesión de CBT aliviar la depresión?
stories.headline: Una jornada de terapia cognitivo-conductual reduce síntomas depresivos y de ansiedad
stories.finding: En un ensayo controlado aleatorizado con 60 pacientes con trastorno depresivo mayor en China, una intervención de un día de CBT redujo significativamente los síntomas depresivos y de ansiedad y mejoró la autoestima frente a una lista de espera. Los efectos persistieron a las dos semanas.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo muestra que una terapia breve y de bajo costo puede producir mejoras clínicas rápidas en depresión y ansiedad, facilitando su escalabilidad en entornos con recursos limitados y ofreciendo una alternativa viable al tratamiento tradicional prolongado.
stories.paperTitle: One-Day Cognitive Behavioural Therapy for Major Depressive Disorder: A Randomised Controlled Trial in China
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract Objective The translation of evidence-based psychological treatments into accessible, real-world care remains a central challenge in global mental health implementation. Although approximately 3.4% of Chinese adults meet criteria for Major Depressive Disorder (MDD), only around 12% receive any form of treatment. Developing brief, low-intensity psychological interventions that can be feasibly delivered at scale is therefore a pressing clinical and public health priority. Method This randomised controlled trial evaluated the effectiveness of a one-day CBT workshop (ODCBT) in reducing depression and anxiety symptoms and improving self-esteem among patients with MDD in mainland China. Sixty patients were randomly assigned to either the ODCBT condition or a wait-list control group, with outcomes assessed at baseline, immediately post-intervention, and at two-week follow-up. Results Compared with the wait-list group, patients receiving ODCBT demonstrated significant reductions in depressive and anxiety symptoms alongside significant improvements in self-esteem. These findings are consistent with prior one-day CBT trials and indicate that a single-session group format can produce clinically meaningful change. Conclusions ODCBT represents a scalable, low-resource intervention with potential for integration into stepped-care frameworks, offering a practical pathway toward addressing China’s depression treatment gap and informing future training and implementation efforts. Trial Registration : ChiCTR2400093783 Chinese Clinical Trial Registry https://clinicaltrials.gov/ct2/show/ChiCTR2400093783 .

stories.hook: ¿Por qué la rumiación empeora la procrastinación?
stories.headline: La rumiación autocrítica media entre perfeccionismo y procrastinación académica
stories.finding: En una muestra de 712 estudiantes universitarios (18‑33 años) se confirmó que la escala de Rumiación Autocrítica es válida y fiable en contexto turco. El análisis de mediación mostró que la rumiación autocrítica explica la relación entre perfeccionismo desadaptativo y la procrastinación académica.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que intervenir la rumiación autocrítica podría reducir la procrastinación en estudiantes perfeccionistas, ofreciendo una diana terapéutica concreta para mejorar el rendimiento académico y el bienestar.
stories.paperTitle: Öz Eleştirel Ruminasyon Ölçeğinin Psikometrik Özelliklerinin İncelenmesi ve Üniversite Öğrencilerindeki Mükemmeliyetçilik ile Akademik Erteleme İlişkilerinde Öz Eleştirel Ruminasyonun Aracılık Rolü
stories.originalAbstract: Bu araştırmanın amacı Öz Eleştirel Ruminasyon Ölçeğinin Türk kültüründeki psikometrik özelliklerini ortaya koymak ve üniversite öğrencilerinin mükemmeliyetçilik ile akademik erteleme davranışları arasındaki ilişkide öz eleştirel ruminasyonun aracılık rolünün incelemektir. Bu amaç doğrultusunda ilk olarak 2018-2019 Eğitim Öğretim yılı Güz döneminde Muğla Sıtkı Koçman Üniversitesinde öğrenim gören 282 lisans öğrencisine ulaşılmıştır. Elde edilen veriler doğrultusunda Doğrulayıcı Faktör Analizi yapılmıştır. Yapılan geçerlik ve güvenirlik analizleri sonucunda Öz Eleştirel Ruminasyon Ölçeğinin Türk kültüründe geçerli ve güvenilir bir ölçme aracı olduğu sonucuna varılmıştır. Ardından mükemmeliyetçilik, öz eleştirel ruminasyon ve akademik erteleme davranışı arasındaki ilişkiyi incelemek ve öz eleştirel ruminasyonun aracılık rolünü ortaya koymak amacıyla yaşları 18 ile 33 arasında değişen 712 lisans öğrencisine ölçek uygulaması yapılmıştır. Elde edilen verilerle Basit Aracılık Analizi yapılmıştır. Verilerin analizinde Jamovi ve RStudio programlarından yararlanılmıştır. Elde edilen bulgulara göre uyumsuz mükemmeliyetçilik ile akademik erteleme davranışı arasındaki ilişkide öz eleştirel ruminasyonun tam aracı rolünün olduğu görülmüştür. Öte yandan uyumlu mükemmeliyetçilik ile akademik erteleme arasında düşük düzeyde negatif ve anlamlı bir ilişkinin olduğu görülürken öz eleştirel ruminasyon arasında anlamlı herhangi bir ilişkiye rastlanmamıştır. Son olarak elde edilen bulgular alanyazındaki çalışmalar doğrultusunda tartışılmış ve hem araştırmacılara hem de uygulayıcılara yönelik önerilerde bulunulmuştur.

stories.hook: ¿El trastorno de pánico es realmente categórico?
stories.headline: Análisis taxométrico revela naturaleza dimensional del trastorno de pánico
stories.finding: El estudio aplicó tres procedimientos taxométricos a datos del Panic Disorder Severity Scale de 663 participantes y obtuvo un puntaje medio CCFI de .39, indicando soporte consistente para un modelo dimensional. Estos resultados cuestionan la clasificación categórica tradicional del trastorno de pánico.
stories.takeaway: Implica que la evaluación y el tratamiento deberían orientarse a la gravedad continua, facilitando intervenciones personalizadas y mejorando el acceso a terapias basadas en la intensidad de los síntomas.
stories.paperTitle: A taxometric analysis of panic disorder
stories.originalAbstract: Panic disorder is costly, and while evidence-based interventions for panic disorder are effective, obtaining a diagnosis often precludes access to such treatments. This is problematic because the categorical diagnosis of panic disorder (i.e. "you have it, or you don't") supported by modern diagnostic manuals contradicts empirically supported dimensional models of panic disorder. Taxometric analyses, which test the dimensional or categorical latent structure of constructs, have consistently revealed dimensional latent structures when applied to other anxiety disorders and panic-related processes, but taxometric analyses have never been applied to panic disorder. To address this gap in the literature, three nonredundant taxometric procedures were applied to seven theoretically-relevant indicators of panic disorder derived from Panic Disorder Severity Scale data collected from 663 participants recruited via Amazon Mechanical Turk. Simulated comparison plots and objective fit indices were also evaluated. The collective results provided consistent empirical support for a dimensional model of panic disorder, with an overall mean CCFI score of .39. The implications of the present findings for the measurement, assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of panic disorder are discussed.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la psicoeducación reducir el PTSD sin terapia intensiva?
stories.headline: La psicoeducación disminuye significativamente los síntomas de PTSD según 26 ensayos controlados
stories.finding: Una revisión sistemática de 26 ensayos controlados aleatorios (N=3.304) evaluó intervenciones psicoeducativas para el PTSD en adultos. Nueve de los ensayos reportaron reducciones significativas de los síntomas de PTSD, destacando la efectividad de formatos y entregas específicas.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo respalda la inclusión de la psicoeducación como primera línea de intervención, ofreciendo una opción de bajo costo y accesible que puede aliviar síntomas de PTSD antes de iniciar terapias más intensivas.
stories.paperTitle: Psychoeducation for posttraumatic stress disorder in adults: a systematic review of formats and delivery approaches
stories.originalAbstract: Introduction: Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is a prevalent mental health condition that may develop following direct or indirect exposure to traumatic events. Psychoeducation offers a low-cost and accessible entry point to care. This review aimed to evaluate the effects of psychoeducation for PTSD and identify the conditions and delivery formats associated with greater effectiveness.Methods: We conducted a systematic review of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating psychoeducational interventions for PTSD in adults. Searches were performed in PubMed, ScienceDirect, Web of Science, PTSDpubs, and Cochrane databases, covering 1 January 2000 to 30 April 2024 with an additional targeted search for PTSD Coach trials conducted in July and August 2026. Eligible studies included adult participants and assessed psychoeducation delivered as either a stand-alone or primary component. Findings were synthesized narratively.Results: Twenty-six RCTs with a total of 3,304 participants met the inclusion criteria. Psychoeducational interventions varied substantially in format, duration, and delivery.Discussion: Nine trials demonstrated significant reductions in PTSD symptoms attributable to psychoeducation (one preventive intervention and eight post-diagnosis). All trials showing significant between-group effects used digital delivery, and most included form of human guidance. However, overall treatment effects were inconsistent across studies, and the methodological quality of the evidence was limited, with several positive trials presenting some concerns or a high risk of bias. Several trials also reported improvements in outcomes such as perceived stress, anxiety, stigma, and help-seeking intentions.Conclusion: Psychoeducation alone is insufficient as a stand-alone treatment for PTSD but remains a valuable component of stepped-care approaches. Future research should systematically assess outcomes such as stigma reduction and help-seeking behaviours, which are critical for engagement in intensive therapies. Preventive interventions may also benefit from focusing on high-risk populations identified through established risk factors, thereby enhancing trial design and minimizing the inclusion of individuals likely to remit without intervention.Registration: This review was not prospectively registered.

stories.hook: ¿Qué prácticas parentales favorecen la recuperación tras traumas infantiles?
stories.headline: Delphi define 94 estrategias parentales para ansiedad y depresión post‑trauma
stories.finding: Un panel de 38 expertos evaluó 166 estrategias y alcanzó consenso en 94 (56,6 %). Las estrategias aprobadas priorizan la estabilización, seguridad emocional, ritmo guiado por el niño, validación y autorregulación parental, mientras rechazan enfoques prescriptivos.
stories.takeaway: Proporciona una guía basada en evidencia para padres y terapeutas, facilitando intervenciones centradas en el apego y la regulación emocional tras eventos traumáticos.
stories.paperTitle: Identifying Parenting Strategies to Support Young People with Trauma-Related Anxiety and Depression: A Delphi Consensus Study
stories.originalAbstract: Trauma exposure is common in young people and is associated with anxiety, depression, and other mental health difficulties. Parents play an important role in supporting their child's recovery following a potentially traumatic event, yet evidence-based guidance for trauma-informed parenting remains limited. This study used a Delphi methodology to establish expert consensus on parenting strategies for young people aged 5-18 years experiencing anxiety and depressive symptoms following a traumatic event. A panel of 38 predominantly Australian clinicians and researchers with expertise in trauma, youth mental health, and parenting rated 166 candidate strategies across three survey rounds for their importance in supporting young people's post-trauma mental health. Ninety-four strategies (56.6%) achieved expert consensus, defined as endorsement by 90% or more of the panel, and were consolidated into freely available parenting guidelines. Endorsed strategies emphasised stabilisation and emotional safety prior to trauma-focused engagement, child-led pacing, emotional validation, and parental self-regulation. Resilience-promoting and prescriptive strategies were consistently rejected, reflecting expert preference for responsive over directive approaches. The expert panel primarily comprised professionals from Western countries, which may limit the applicability of the strategies across culturally diverse contexts. To our knowledge, this is the first study to establish expert consensus on parenting strategies specifically for young people experiencing trauma-related anxiety and depression. The pattern of endorsement and rejection reveals key principles for parent-led post-trauma support and offers a foundation for developing and evaluating low-intensity parenting interventions.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la IA sustituir al terapeuta psicoanalítico?
stories.headline: La IA no puede replicar la lógica inconsciente ni la contención terapéutica
stories.finding: El artículo analiza críticamente por qué los algoritmos de inteligencia artificial no pueden captar las estructuras inconscientes ni la dinámica intersubjetiva del proceso terapéutico. Un caso clínico muestra que la IA no logra abordar ansiedad por separación o la identificación proyectiva, ni reproducir silencios significativos, contratransferencia ni contención emocional.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo alerta a profesionales y desarrolladores de que la sustitución de la relación terapéutica por IA ignora componentes esenciales del inconsciente y la contención, limitando la efectividad clínica y subrayando la necesidad de preservar la presencia humana en la psicoterapia.
stories.paperTitle: Beyond the black box: why algorithms cannot replace the unconscious or the psychodynamic therapist
stories.originalAbstract: This paper critically examines the limitations of artificial intelligence in replicating human psychological processes, specifically challenging its ability to capture the complex structures of the unconscious and the nuanced dynamics of psychotherapeutic relationships. Drawing on psychoanalytic theory, particularly Matte-Blanco's analysis of unconscious logic and Winnicott's concept of therapeutic holding, the research demonstrates that AI fundamentally fails to engage with the non-linear, contradictory, and embodied nature of human psychological experience. To substantiate these theoretical claims, the paper presents a clinical vignette that illustrates AI's profound therapeutic shortcomings, specifically its inability to address complex psychological issues like separation anxiety and projective identification. The case study highlights critical therapeutic elements AI cannot replicate, such as meaningful silence, nuanced countertransference, and embodied emotional containment. While algorithmic systems may superficially mimic pattern recognition, they cannot replicate the profound intersubjective, temporal, and affective dimensions of human psychological understanding. The study warns of a more insidious risk: patients potentially modifying their psychological self-presentation to conform to computational logic, thereby sanitizing and distorting their complex inner experiences. Ultimately, the paper argues that AI's limitations are structural rather than technical, emphasizing the irreplaceable role of embodied, relational human connection in psychological care and understanding, while acknowledging AI's potential supplementary functions in mental healthcare.

stories.hook: ¿Puede el pensamiento racional cambiar la actividad cerebral?
stories.headline: Creer racionalmente intensifica la actividad en cuneus, temporal y ínsula durante estrés
stories.finding: Setenta y cinco participantes fueron asignados aleatoriamente a grupos de creencias racionales o irracionales y escaneados con fMRI mientras imaginaban escenarios estresantes. El grupo racional mostró actividad significativamente mayor en el cuneus derecho, el giro temporal superior y la ínsula, lo que sugiere una regulación más eficaz del arousal.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo indica que entrenar creencias racionales podría modular circuitos neurales implicados en la regulación emocional, ofreciendo una base neurobiológica para intervenciones cognitivo‑conductuales orientadas a mejorar la gestión del estrés.
stories.paperTitle: The effects of rational and irrational beliefs on brain response to emotional scenarios: An fMRI study
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract Introduction: This study aimed to investigate the neural correlates of adopting rational versus irrational beliefs in response to emotionally stressful scenarios, utilizing functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI). Grounded in Rational Emotive Behavior Therapy (REBT), we explored how endorsing rational or irrational beliefs modulates brain activity while evaluating hypothetical stressful situations. Methods: Seventy-five participants (48 females, aged 19–35) were randomly assigned to a rational or irrational belief group. Participants underwent fMRI while imagining emotionally stressful scenarios and endorsing corresponding beliefs. Results: We found that a rational way of approaching a given emotionally stressful scenario was associated with significantly higher activity in the right cuneus, superior temporal gyrus, and insula compared to the irrational thinking group. Discussions: The current result suggests that participants adopting a rational approach toward the unpleasant scenarios were able to generate better mental representations of the scenes, likely because rational thinking allows for improved regulation of the unpleasant arousal that these emotionally stressful scenarios could trigger. Interventions targeting irrational beliefs and promoting rational thinking, such as REBT, promise to improve emotional functioning and facilitate a more adaptive approach to negative scenarios.

stories.hook: ¿Puede el sueño profundo limpiar la mente?
stories.headline: El sistema glinfático vincula el sueño profundo con trastornos psiquiátricos
stories.finding: Los investigadores proponen que la disfunción del sistema glinfático, responsable de eliminar desechos metabólicos durante el sueño profundo, favorece la acumulación de proteínas neurotóxicas e inflamación, lo que podría exacerbar insomnio y trastornos psiquiátricos. Señalan que técnicas de neuroimagen, como el índice ALPS, permiten cuantificar déficits de flujo perivascular.
stories.takeaway: Comprender el papel del sistema glinfático abre nuevas vías para intervenir en el sueño profundo y, potencialmente, prevenir o aliviar trastornos mentales mediante estrategias que mejoren la eliminación de desechos cerebrales, como terapias de sueño o modulaciones de la aquaporina‑4.
stories.paperTitle: Glymphatic system and psychiatric disorders: need for a new paradigm?
stories.originalAbstract: Psychiatric disorders like depression, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, and post-traumatic stress Disorder have conventionally theorized on alterations in neurotransmitters, receptor pharmacodynamics, and neural connectivity. However, recent research points to a complementary framework involving the glymphatic system, a specialized glial lymphatic pathway that removes metabolic waste products, particularly during deep sleep, through the coordinated action of cerebrospinal fluid, interstitial fluid, and the aquaporin 4 channels of astrocytes. When the glymphatic network is compromised, neurotoxic proteins, such as beta-amyloid and tau, and inflammatory mediators can accumulate, potentially exacerbating insomnia, inflammation, and circadian disturbances. These same processes often occur in psychiatric disorders, fueling oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, and cognitive decline. New neuroimaging methods, such as diffusion tensor imaging and the analysis Along the Perivascular Space, ALPS, index, allow clinicians and researchers to quantify perivascular flow deficits in vivo . Preliminary evidence suggests that enhancing glymphatic function by improving sleep architecture, supporting astrocyte health, or scheduling drug delivery based on circadian fluctuations may offer clinical benefits. Here, we present an overview of glymphatic biology, examine its relevance to psychiatric pathophysiology, highlight findings from emerging neuroimaging studies, and consider ways modulating glymphatic flow may improve psychiatric pharmacotherapy.

stories.hook: ¿Puede el mindfulness mejorar el rendimiento deportivo?
stories.headline: Los entrenamientos de mindfulness aumentan el rendimiento y reducen la ansiedad competitiva
stories.finding: La revisión sistemática incluyó 17 ensayos controlados que evaluaron intervenciones de mindfulness de varias sesiones en atletas competitivos. La mayoría de los estudios mostró mejoras en el rendimiento, sobre todo en tareas de precisión y resistencia, y una disminución de la ansiedad competitiva.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo respalda la incorporación de programas de mindfulness en la preparación deportiva, ofreciendo una herramienta basada en evidencia para optimizar el desempeño y gestionar la presión competitiva, lo que puede traducirse en mejores resultados y bienestar del atleta.
stories.paperTitle: Effectiveness of multi-session mindfulness-based interventions on sport performance and competitive anxiety in competitive athletes: a systematic review of controlled trials
stories.journal: Journal of Counseling Education and Society
stories.originalAbstract: Competitive athletes perform under evaluative pressure, and competitive anxiety threatens sport performance. Mindfulness-based interventions (MBIs) are increasingly adopted in applied sport psychology, yet controlled evidence on their effects on performance and anxiety remains fragmented. This review synthesised controlled trials examining whether structured multi-session MBIs improve performance and reduce competitive anxiety in competitive athletes, and which programme characteristics accompany favourable outcomes. The review followed the PRISMA 2020 statement and a PICOS framework. Scopus was searched with a Boolean string combining mindfulness, athlete or sport, and performance or competitive anxiety terms, limited to English-language open-access journal articles published between 2016 and 2025, yielding 521 records. Eligible studies were randomised or non-randomised controlled trials of multi-session MBIs reporting objective or observer-rated sport performance or competitive or sport anxiety; single-session, uncontrolled, and non-athlete studies were excluded. Seventeen studies met the criteria. Most reported performance gains, particularly in precision and endurance tasks such as free throws, shooting, and rowing, whereas anxiety effects were less consistent and sometimes matched by psychological skills training. Sport-specific programmes lasting six to eight weeks appeared most promising. The findings support MBIs as a complementary performance tool, while larger preregistered trials with follow-up and objective outcomes are needed.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué tantos profesionales de salud se sienten impostores?
stories.headline: El 62 % de los proveedores de salud sufre síndrome del impostor
stories.finding: Un meta‑análisis que incluyó 30 estudios y 11 483 participantes estimó que la prevalencia global del síndrome del impostor entre los proveedores de salud es del 62 % (IC 95 %: 52,6–70,6). El análisis también reveló que la heterogeneidad entre estudios está influenciada por el tamaño de la muestra, indicando variaciones en la estimación según la magnitud de los estudios.
stories.takeaway: Este dato alerta a la comunidad clínica sobre la alta frecuencia del síndrome del impostor, lo que sugiere la necesidad de incorporar evaluaciones rutinarias y programas de autocompasión y fortalecimiento de la autoestima en entornos sanitarios.
stories.paperTitle: Global prevalence of imposter syndrome in health service providers: a systematic review and meta-analysis
stories.originalAbstract: Background Imposterism, also known as imposter syndrome or imposter phenomenon, is an emerging phenomenon that has attracted much attention in recent years. Given that this phenomenon is common among high-achieving individuals and its identification often overlaps with symptoms of anxiety, depression, stress, and burnout, the aim of this study is to determine the global prevalence of imposter syndrome and its associated factors. Methods For this study, PubMed, Embase, ScienceDirect Web of Science, Scopus, and Google Scholar databases were systematically searched, and all relevant studies were transferred to EndNote (v.8) and reviewed. Data analysis was performed using Comprehensive Meta-Analysis (v.2) software; a random effects model was adopted for analysis, and the I2 index was used to examine the heterogeneity of studies. Results In a review of 30 studies with a sample size of 11,483 people, the prevalence of imposter syndrome was 62% (95% CI: 52.6–70.6) based on meta-analysis and the random effects method. In examining the factors affecting the heterogeneity of studies and the effect of sample size on this heterogeneity, it was found that with increasing sample size, the prevalence of imposter syndrome decreases (p < 0.05), and with increasing years of studies, the prevalence of imposter syndrome increases (p < 0.05). Additionally, in this study, self-esteem, anxiety, depression, stress, and burnout were identified as the most important factors associated with imposter syndrome. Conclusion Given the relatively high prevalence of imposter syndrome, which is a serious psychological challenge and can negatively affect the mental health and performance of individuals, the results of this study provide useful information for designing appropriate policies and interventions to develop effective pertinent solutions.

stories.hook: ¿El exceso de trabajo impulsa el burnout?
stories.headline: Sobrecarga laboral se asocia positivamente con burnout y abandono
stories.finding: Una revisión sistemática con meta‑análisis incluyó 34 estudios, de los cuales 5 aportaron seis muestras independientes. Los análisis revelaron asociaciones positivas entre la sobrecarga de trabajo y el burnout, entre sobrecarga y la intención de abandono, y entre burnout y abandono.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo subraya que reducir la carga laboral es clave para prevenir el burnout y la rotación, orientando intervenciones organizacionales en entornos de salud.
stories.paperTitle: Work Demands, Burnout, and Withdrawal Behaviors Among Healthcare Workers: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
stories.originalAbstract: OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to determine whether work demands-specifically work overload and mental workload-are associated with burnout and withdrawal behaviors among healthcare workers, and to estimate the magnitude of these associations. METHOD: A systematic review with meta-analysis and exploratory structural meta-analytic modeling was conducted, following the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. The search covered Web of Science, Scopus, and PubMed/MEDLINE with no restrictions on publication year, yielding 34 studies. Of these, five studies providing six independent samples with comparable data were included in three bivariate random-effects meta-analyses using REML and Fisher's z-transformation, as well as a two-stage TSSEM to explore the statistical indirect association involving burnout. RESULTS: This review identified heterogeneity in the constructs and instruments used, as well as consistent associations between the variables of interest. The meta-analyses showed positive associations between work overload and burnout, work overload and turnover intention, and burnout and turnover intention. Work overload showed comparatively more homogeneous associations with both burnout and turnover intention, whereas the burnout-turnover intention association showed greater between-study heterogeneity. The exploratory TSSEM showed an indirect association between work overload and turnover intention through burnout, alongside an association between work overload and turnover intention conditional on burnout. CONCLUSIONS: Work demands are associated with burnout and withdrawal behaviors. The findings suggest that work overload shows comparatively more consistent associations with burnout and turnover intention, whereas the burnout-turnover intention association appears more sensitive to contextual and measurement-related factors. Burnout may be a relevant correlate within the association between work overload and turnover intention, although longitudinal evidence is needed to establish temporal relationships.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué la comunicación sexual mejora la satisfacción vital?
stories.headline: La comunicación sexual predice mayor satisfacción sexual, de pareja y vital
stories.finding: En una muestra de 7 139 adultos de seis países europeos, cada faceta de la comunicación sexual (autorrevelación, frecuencia y calidad) se asoció positivamente con mayores niveles de satisfacción sexual, de relación y de vida. Los predictores más fuertes fueron la frecuencia sexual y la insatisfacción por su escasa frecuencia.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo subraya la importancia de abordar la comunicación sexual en terapia de pareja, pues mejorar la calidad y frecuencia del intercambio puede elevar la satisfacción global y el bienestar de los individuos.
stories.paperTitle: Sociodemographic Predictors of Sexual Communication and Sexual Communication as a Predictor of Sexual, Relationship, and Life Satisfaction in Denmark, Finland, France, Norway, Sweden, and the UK
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract Sexual communication is associated with higher levels of sexual and relationship satisfaction. However, research suggests that many struggle with sexual communication. Using a cross-country convenience sample of 7,139 respondents from six European countries (Denmark, Finland, France, Norway, Sweden, and the UK), we investigated sociodemographic predictors of different facets of sexual communication and their associations with sexual, relationship, and life satisfaction. Data was collected in May and June 2022 through respondent panels, by Cint, a market research software platform. Participants received an email invitation to the study and completed an online self-report survey. We found that a large proportion did report difficulties with sexual communication or a wish to improve such communication. We also found that sociodemographic factors predicted each facet (self-disclosure, frequency of communication, and quality of communication) of sexual communication as a set, but that the strongest predictors were sexual frequency and dissatisfaction with the low frequency of sex. Lastly, each facet of sexual communication was associated with higher levels of sexual, relationship, and life satisfaction. Across results, we generally found little cross-country variation.

stories.hook: ¿Puede una pequeña señal diaria impulsar creatividad y altruismo?
stories.headline: El auto‑nudging físico aumenta vigor, creatividad y comportamiento prosocial en empleados
stories.finding: En un estudio de 182 empleados que completaron encuestas diarias durante cinco días, el auto‑nudging hacia la actividad física se relacionó positivamente con la creatividad y el comportamiento prosocial a través del vigor, controlando los niveles previos. Además, se observaron efectos directos de auto‑nudging sobre ambos resultados no objetivo.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que intervenciones simples de auto‑nudging pueden potenciar recursos psicológicos y conductas prosociales en el entorno laboral, ofreciendo una estrategia de bajo costo para mejorar el bienestar y la innovación organizacional.
stories.paperTitle: Daily self-nudging towards physical activity: implications for vigour, creativity, and prosocial work behavior
stories.journal: European Journal of Work and Organizational Psychology
stories.originalAbstract: This study integrates nudging and proactivity theories to investigate how individuals can nudge themselves to be more physically active. We test the daily effects of self-nudging on vigour and use the dual pathway to creativity model to predict indirect effects on two non-targeted outcomes: creativity and prosocial behaviour. One hundred eighty-two (NL2 = 182) employees filled out a short survey for five consecutive days (NL1 = 672). Results of multilevel structural equation modelling provide evidence for the hypothesized model. Daily self-nudging towards physical activity was positively related to (a) creativity and (b) prosocial behaviour through vigour (a combination of physical strength and cognitive liveliness) – after controlling for previous-day levels of the mediator and outcomes. Self-nudging also showed direct effects on the two non-targeted outcomes. These findings offer support for nudging theory and the dual pathway to creativity model. We discuss the theoretical implications and three practical applications.

stories.hook: ¿Recibir gratitud impulsa más la perseverancia infantil?
stories.headline: Recibir gratitud aumenta la tenacidad y conducta prosocial en niños más que expresarla
stories.finding: En tres experimentos de campo realizados en escuelas, se comparó a niños que recibían gratitud con aquellos que solo la expresaban. Los resultados mostraron que recibir gratitud favoreció mayores niveles de tenacidad (grit), conducta prosocial y autoestima.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que intervenciones educativas que incluyan el reconocimiento activo de los niños pueden fortalecer su resiliencia y comportamiento cooperativo, ofreciendo una herramienta sencilla para promover el desarrollo socioemocional en contextos escolares.
stories.paperTitle: Understanding the Impact of Receiving Gratitude and Goal-Oriented Nudges on Children’s Success
stories.journal: Digital Eprints Services at ISB (DESI) (Indian School of Business)
stories.originalAbstract: Introduction This dissertation explores the impact of external factors, specifically receiving gratitude and goal-oriented nudges, on children’s social and academic development. The research contributes to the fields of children’s consumer behavior and behavioral science by examining how external reinforcements shape children's prosocial behavior, perseverance, and performance. The dissertation consists of two essays that employ field experiments to examine the causal effects of gratitude and nudging interventions. Essay 1: Receiving Gratitude enhances Grit and Prosocial Behavior more than Expressing Gratitude Prior research has extensively examined the benefits of expressing gratitude, but little attention has been given to how receiving gratitude (being thanked for helping others) affects the recipient, especially in children. This study investigates whether receiving gratitude fosters higher levels of prosocial behavior, grit, and self-esteem in children compared to merely expressing gratitude. Three field experiments were conducted in school settings. Specifically, Study 1 compared prosocial intent of children receiving gratitude versus those expressing gratitude in a teacher-child interaction. Study 2 examined peer-peer interaction and measured actual prosocial behavior (e.g., willingness to donate or volunteer). In Study 3, a longitudinal design was used to track the long-term effects of receiving gratitude on prosocial behavior, persistence, and self-concept. Findings reveal that being thanked enhances prosocial behavior, increases grit, and strengthens self-esteem, and the role of grit in shaping social behavior. Key Contributions and Implications This study extends gratitude research by demonstrating that receiving gratitude fosters long-term prosocial motivation and persistence, shifting the focus from traditional gratitude interventions that emphasize expressing gratitude. These insights can extend beyond educational to business and management settings, suggesting that fostering a culture of appreciation and recognition has the potential to enhance team cohesion and employee engagement. Essay 2: The Role of Subgoal-Oriented Nudges in Improving Academic Performance This essay examines whether structured subgoal-oriented nudges improve children's academic habits and performance. An eight-month field experiment was conducted with students preparing for a competitive examination to examine the impact of nudging students for completion and submission of assignment on test performance. The experiment was divided into three phases. In the Pre-Nudge Phase assignment submissions were monitored without students being nudged. In the Nudge Phase students received regular goal-oriented nudges encouraging assignment completion and submission along with monitoring of assignments. The final phase was the Post-Nudge Phase where the nudges were withdrawn to assess the persistence effect of the nudge, while monitoring continued. The results indicate that nudges improved test performance, particularly among students with lower self-discipline and lower motivation. However, the effectiveness of nudging varied by gender, with male students benefiting more than female students, raising questions about gendered responses to behavioral interventions. The findings also reveal sustained positive impact of subgoal-oriented nudges, even after the nudges were discontinued. Key Contributions and Implications This study highlights the effectiveness of subgoal-oriented nudges as an intervention to improve performance, which has applications in both education and business contexts. The findings reveal that habit-building mechanisms can be sustained using nudges. In business environments, these findings are suggestive of possible usage of structured nudges for performance tracking, milestone reminders, among others which can enhance employee productivity and facilitate goal completion. The gender differences observed underscore the need for customized strategies, emphasizing gender specific goal-setting approaches in corporate leadership and human resource development. Conclusion By combining insights from children consumer behavior, behavioral science, psychology, and management research, this dissertation provides a deeper understanding of how external reinforcements shape children’s behavior and performance. The findings underscore the power of receiving gratitude and structured nudges in fostering sustained behavioral change, offering actionable strategies that may also be applicable in organizational settings.

stories.hook: ¿Cuántas personas viven duelo prolongado tras la COVID-19?
stories.headline: El 24 % de los adultos bereavidos presentan duelo prolongado
stories.finding: Una revisión sistemática y meta‑análisis de 13 estudios (N = 5 766) estimó que la prevalencia de duelo prolongado durante la pandemia fue del 24 %. El intervalo de confianza del 95 % (13 %–36 %) indica una variabilidad considerable, subrayando la magnitud del problema en la población adulta que sufrió pérdidas.
stories.takeaway: Este dato alerta a profesionales de salud mental sobre la alta carga de duelo prolongado tras la COVID‑19, justificando la detección temprana y la implementación de intervenciones específicas para prevenir deterioro funcional y sufrimiento crónico.
stories.paperTitle: Global prevalence of prolonged grief disorder during the COVID-19 pandemic under standardized diagnostic frameworks: A systematic review and meta-analysis
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract Prolonged grief disorder (PGD), recently classified in ICD-11 and DSM-5-TR, is characterized by persistent and functionally impairing grief lasting beyond 6–12 months. The COVID-19 pandemic was accompanied by widespread mortality, social isolation, disrupted mourning rituals, and social disconnection, raising concerns about a potentially high burden of PGD during the pandemic period. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis, following PRISMA guidelines and PROSPERO registration (CRD42023463720), to estimate PGD prevalence under standardized ICD-11 and DSM-5-TR diagnostic frameworks and to examine potential moderators during the COVID-19 pandemic. PubMed, EMBASE, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception to October 2024. Eligible studies included adults who experienced bereavement during the pandemic and were assessed using validated PGD instruments (PG-13-R, ICG, BGQ). Random-effects models were applied to pool prevalence estimates, with subgroup and meta-regression analyses. Thirteen studies comprising 5,766 participants were included. The pooled prevalence of PGD during the pandemic period was 24% (95% CI: 13%–36%), with the highest estimates observed in China (43%, 95% CI: 33%–54%). In the overall pooled analysis, studies applying DSM-5-TR criteria yielded lower prevalence estimates than those using ICD-11 criteria (18% vs.26%, p = 0.41). Digital interventions showed no statistically significant pooled effects (Hedges’ g = −0.38, 95% CI: −0.90 to 0.14). The high and geographically heterogeneous prevalence of PGD observed during the COVID-19 pandemic underscores the need to strengthen mental health surveillance, standardized assessment, and service accessibility in large-scale public health emergencies, and provides important evidence to inform population-level interventions and resource allocation strategies.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la voz revelar el ADHD y su tratamiento?
stories.headline: Características de la voz distinguen niños con ADHD y reflejan efecto de metilfenidato
stories.finding: En la evaluación basal, los 27 niños con ADHD mostraron un tono fundamental medio más bajo y mayor variabilidad que los 27 controles neurotípicos. En la visita de seguimiento bajo metilfenidato, se observó una tendencia a la normalización del tono y su variabilidad, indicando que los rasgos de voz pueden servir como marcadores objetivos del efecto del tratamiento.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que el análisis acústico de la voz podría complementar la evaluación clínica del ADHD y ofrecer una herramienta objetiva y escalable para monitorizar la eficacia del metilfenidato en la práctica cotidiana.
stories.paperTitle: Voice features in paediatric ADHD: baseline group differences and longitudinal change under methylphenidate
stories.originalAbstract: Diagnosis and treatment monitoring of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) largely rely on subjective assessments, highlighting the need for objective markers. Voice features and speech embeddings represent promising candidates, as they may offer an objective, scalable and clinically valuable complement to current practice. Yet it remains largely unclear which features are most informative for distinguishing ADHD and monitoring treatment effects, and which speech tasks best elicit these differences. Twenty-seven children with ADHD and 27 age-matched neurotypical controls completed six speech tasks across two study visits. Children with ADHD were unmedicated at baseline and were assessed under prescribed methylphenidate treatment at follow-up, whereas controls underwent repeated assessment without intervention. Established acoustic voice features and high-dimensional speech embeddings were extracted and analysed using linear mixed models to examine baseline group differences and group-by-time interaction effects reflecting medication-associated change patterns. At baseline, children with ADHD showed a lower and more variable pitch (F0 mean, F0 variability), altered spectral properties (MFCC1/MFCC2 variability), and reduced rhythmic stability (variability of voiced-segment length) compared to controls. Group-by-time interaction effects indicated medication-associated modulation in the ADHD group, including reduced loudness variability and normalization of first formant bandwidth toward control values. Speech embeddings (Whisper but not WavLM) showed FDR-significant baseline and interaction effects. Free speech tasks, particularly picture description, yielded the most robust and consistent effects. These findings support further investigation of speech-based measures as potential digital biomarkers in ADHD, with picture description emerging as a particularly promising task for future clinical assessment protocols.Clinical trial registration: German Clinical Trials Registry, registration no. DRKS00030766, Registration Date: 12 December 2022. Available: https://drks.de/search/en/trial/DRKS00030766.

Speech embeddings (Whisper but not WavLM) showed FDR-significant baseline and interaction effects. Free speech tasks, particularly picture description, yielded the most robust and consistent effects. These findings support further investigation of speech-based measures as potential digital biomarkers in ADHD, with picture description emerging as a particularly promising task for future clinical assessment protocols.Clinical trial registration: German Clinical Trials Registry, registration no. DRKS00030766, Registration Date: 12 December 2022. Available: https://drks.de/search/en/trial/DRKS00030766.

stories.hook: ¿Puede el estilo autoritario compensar el riesgo cognitivo prematuro?
stories.headline: Niños prematuros presentan IQ reducido y el estilo autoritario atenúa el impacto familiar
stories.finding: En una muestra de 135 niños prematuros (edad media 8,67 años) se observó un IQ total significativamente inferior a la población normativa (t=-6.68, p<0.001, d=-0.58). Los análisis de mediación mostraron que un estilo de crianza autoritativo explica parcialmente la asociación entre riesgo socio‑familiar y desempeño intelectual.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que promover un estilo de crianza autoritativo podría mitigar las consecuencias cognitivas del nacimiento prematuro, orientando intervenciones familiares en la práctica clínica y educativa.
stories.paperTitle: Cognitive Functioning in Very Preterm Children and Links With Socio‐Family Risk and Parenting
stories.originalAbstract: Children born very preterm are at elevated risk of developing cognitive difficulties, yet the contribution of family and social factors to their neurodevelopment remains unclear. This cross-sectional study examines their cognitive performance relative to normative standards and uses an exploratory framework linking socio-family risk and intellectual functioning through potential indirect pathways via parenting styles. A sample of 135 children born before 32 weeks of gestation and/or very low birth weight (< 1500 g) (mean age = 8.67 years) was assessed using the Wechsler Intelligence Scale for Children-Fifth Edition (WISC-V). Socio-family risk was measured through a cumulative index, and parenting was evaluated using the Parenting Styles and Dimensions Questionnaire. Very preterm children showed significantly lower average scores across full-scale IQ (t(134) = -6.68, p < 0.001, d = -0.58) and all indices compared to the normative population. Fluid reasoning, working memory, and processing speed showed the greatest vulnerabilities. Mediation analyses suggested that an authoritative parenting style partially accounts for the association between socio-family risk and intellectual outcomes. These findings suggest that positive parenting was associated with better intellectual outcomes and support the potential value of family-centered interventions for very preterm children.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué mejora el paciente antes de activar la estimulación cerebral?
stories.headline: El efecto de inserción de electrodos mejora síntomas antes de la estimulación
stories.finding: Los autores describen que la inserción de electrodos en estimulación cerebral profunda produce una mejoría clínica observable antes de iniciar la estimulación, fenómeno denominado 'efecto de inserción'. Este efecto, atribuido a trauma inicial, inflamación, activación de astrocitos y cambios neuroplásticos, puede sesgar los resultados de ensayos controlados aleatorizados.
stories.takeaway: Reconocer y controlar el efecto de inserción es esencial para diseñar ensayos de estimulación cerebral profunda que evalúen verdaderamente la eficacia de la estimulación, evitando sobreestimar beneficios y mejorando la interpretación clínica y la seguridad del tratamiento.
stories.paperTitle: Insertional effect following electrode implantation: an underreported but important phenomenon
stories.originalAbstract: Deep brain stimulation has revolutionized the treatment of movement disorders and is gaining momentum in the treatment of several other neuropsychiatric disorders. In almost all applications of this therapy, the insertion of electrodes into the target has been shown to induce some degree of clinical improvement prior to stimulation onset. Disregarding this phenomenon, commonly referred to as 'insertional effect', can lead to biased results in clinical trials, as patients receiving sham stimulation may still experience some degree of symptom amelioration. Similar to the clinical scenario, an improvement in behavioural performance following electrode implantation has also been reported in preclinical models. From a neurohistopathologic perspective, the insertion of electrodes into the brain causes an initial trauma and inflammatory response, the activation of astrocytes, a focal release of gliotransmitters, the hyperexcitability of neurons in the vicinity of the implants, as well as neuroplastic and circuitry changes at a distance from the target. Taken together, it would appear that electrode insertion is not an inert process, but rather triggers a cascade of biological processes, and, as such, should be considered alongside the active delivery of stimulation as an active part of the deep brain stimulation therapy.
